description: React component for inviting users via a dialog, including user search, role and workspace selection, and API interactions for inviting users.

classes.name: StyledChip
classes.description: Styled Material UI Chip component with custom background and text color based on chip type.

classes.name: StyledPopper
classes.description: Styled Material UI Popper component with custom box-shadow and listbox styles.

methods.name: saveInvite
methods.description: Handles the process of inviting selected users, including validation, API calls, and snackbar notifications.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates selected users list based on user input, filtering invalid emails.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Filters user search results based on input value.

methods.name: userSearchFilterOptions
methods.description: Filters autocomplete options, including invite option for partial emails.

methods.name: renderUserSearchInput
methods.description: Renders input field for user search.

methods.name: renderUserSearchOptions
methods.description: Renders each option in user search autocomplete, with selection indicator.

methods.name: renderSelectedUsersTags
methods.description: Renders tags for selected users with tooltips.

methods.name: handleWorkspaceChange
methods.description: Updates selected workspace and user list accordingly.

methods.name: getWorkspaceValue
methods.description: Returns current workspace value for autocomplete.

methods.name: getRoleValue
methods.description: Returns current role value for autocomplete.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the invite button should be disabled.

methods.name: checkWorkspaceDisabled
methods.description: Determines if workspace selection should be disabled.
